html:
Laurent-Désiré Kabila was a Congolese rebel who overthrew Mobutu Sese Seko in 1997 and ruled as president until he was shot by one of his bodyguards in January 2001.

A supporter of Lumumba, he fought in the rebellions of the 1960s and met Che Guevara, who judged him unserious. For decades he ran a small rebel zone and traded gold. In 1996 Rwanda and Uganda made him the face of the First Congo War.

As president he banned parties and fell out with his backers, which led to the Second Congo War. After his assassination his son Joseph Kabila took power at 29 and ruled until 2019, overseeing the peace and the elections of 2006 in the Congo.
sum: Laurent-Désiré Kabila was a Congolese rebel who overthrew Mobutu Sese Seko in 1997 and ruled as president until he was shot by one of his bodyguards in January 2001.
